title: Translyx Ltd launches in New Zealand — bringing innovative diagnostics closer to patients
summary: Translyx Ltd, founded by Dr Ehsan Ullah, launched in New Zealand on a mission to bring advanced diagnostic solutions to the New Zealand and Oceania markets — spanning antimicrobial resistance, sepsis, oncology biomarkers, point-of-care testing, cardiac biomarkers, and endocrine diagnostics.
relevanceToTranslyx: Translyx company milestone establishing the New Zealand bridge between global diagnostic innovation and local clinical practice.

title: Translyx Limited registered in New Zealand, preparing to commence operations
summary: Translyx Limited was officially registered in New Zealand on 17 December 2025 and is preparing to commence operations in 2026, with research and business development teams actively developing the product line and healthcare innovation pipeline.
relevanceToTranslyx: Foundational company update — the formation of the accountable New Zealand entity behind the Translyx platform.

title: Aiforia and Proscia partner to accelerate AI-driven digital pathology
summary: Aiforia Technologies and Proscia announced a non-exclusive partnership to integrate Proscia's Concentriq platform with Aiforia's AI-powered diagnostic applications, aiming to deliver fully integrated, AI-driven digital pathology workflows to laboratories globally.
relevanceToTranslyx: Aiforia is a partner product represented by Translyx in New Zealand; expanding Aiforia integrations strengthen the digital pathology options Translyx can bring to local laboratories.

title: Fimlab expands utilisation of Aiforia's clinical AI solutions
summary: Fimlab, one of the largest clinical laboratory operators in Finland, expanded its use of Aiforia's clinical AI solutions for digital pathology, signalling growing routine clinical adoption of AI-assisted pathology.
relevanceToTranslyx: Demonstrates real-world clinical adoption of Aiforia — directly relevant to how Translyx positions Aiforia for New Zealand pathology groups.

title: Artera receives FDA clearance for ArteraAI Breast, expanding its AI platform
summary: Artera received FDA clearance for ArteraAI Breast — described as the first FDA-cleared digital pathology-based risk stratification tool for early-stage HR+, HER2-negative invasive breast cancer.
relevanceToTranslyx: A landmark digital pathology AI regulatory clearance in oncology, shaping the evidence and governance expectations Translyx applies when evaluating partner AI solutions.

title: National review of pathology services underway in New Zealand
summary: A national review of pathology services is underway in New Zealand, with a 10-year plan being developed for laboratory testing across the public and private sectors.
relevanceToTranslyx: Directly shapes the New Zealand pathology and diagnostics landscape Translyx operates in — relevant to adoption pathways and partnership timing.

title: Australian CDC releases sixth report on antimicrobial use and resistance
source: Australian Commission on Safety and Quality in Health Care
summary: The Australian Centre for Disease Control released its sixth report on antimicrobial use and resistance in human health, drawing on pathology data from across Australia including regional and remote areas.
relevanceToTranslyx: AMR surveillance and diagnostics are a core area of the Translyx diagnostic innovation pipeline; the report underscores regional demand for better AMR testing.

title: Surviving Sepsis Campaign publishes 2026 international guidelines
summary: The Surviving Sepsis Campaign released updated 2026 international guidelines for the management of sepsis and septic shock, with pathogen-specific rapid diagnostic tests suggested on a case-by-case basis in selected patients.
relevanceToTranslyx: Sepsis and point-of-care diagnostics are priority areas in the Translyx pipeline; updated guidelines inform how rapid diagnostics fit clinical pathways.

title: Co:Lab 2026 — New Zealand's pathology lab sector forum to convene in Wellington
summary: Co:Lab 2026, New Zealand's annual gathering for the pathology laboratory sector, will bring together leaders, clinicians, and innovators in Wellington on 2–3 September 2026.
relevanceToTranslyx: A key New Zealand pathology sector event relevant to Translyx's partnerships, stakeholder engagement, and regional adoption work.
